exam_rules.departmental: Departmental subjects normally have MCQ Mid 1 and Mid 2; no ESE unless explicitly approved.
exam_rules.nonDepartmental: Non-departmental subjects normally have theory Mid 1 and ESE, plus MCQ Mid 2.
exam_rules.MCQ: Exactly 30 questions, four options each, answer index 0=A, 1=B, 2=C, 3=D.
exam_rules.theoryMid1: 30 marks: two 1-mark questions; 4-/8-mark questions make up the remaining 28.
exam_rules.theoryESE: 60 marks: two 1-mark questions, one 2-mark question, and 4-/8-mark questions totaling 56. If 2-mark questions are prohibited, resolve the marks conflict before generation.
exam_rules.difficulty: Requested difficulty is generated at runtime. A single reference sample is retained for each available subject/exam type.
